incident-bot: ALERT firing: prod.inference.latency.p99 > 2000ms in eu-west-1 (service: inference-runtime) at 2024-06-21T03:25:45Z
pagerduty: PagerDuty: page fired to @kevin (primary oncall) — incident id PD-98321
kevin: acked — taking ownership, checking dashboards now :eyes:
kevin: quick read: p95 up ~800ms, p99 spikes to 2.3s, error rate flat, throughput normal
kevin: looking at node metrics — high disk io on model-storage-2 and model-loader latency increasing
kevin: running log query: `kubectl logs -n prod model-loader-2 | tail -n 200`
kevin: log snippet:
```
2024-06-21T03:23:12Z model-loader: start load model: open file /models/embedding-v2.bin
2024-06-21T03:23:12Z ORA: read delay: 1800ms
2024-06-21T03:23:13Z model-loader: fallback to remote-streaming
```
kevin: hunch — disk IO saturation (NFS?) causing model cold-starts to blow p99 for some requests
maria: oncall-infra here — I can see a backup/replication job kicked off at 03:20 for model-store snapshots, targeting the same nodes
maria: that backup job is high IO, pausing it now for eu-west snapshot replicate :pause_button:
maria: pausing job -> job_id backup-eu-west-20240621 returned success pause at 03:27
kevin: nice, traffic already starting to normalize on the dashboard — p99 trending down to ~1.4s
kevin: mitigation plan: 1) keep backup paused 2) bump model-loader replicas on affected node pool 3) route new requests to warm pool or fallback quantized model
tarun: I can scale replicas — applying HPA override to model-loader-deployment (replicas 3 -> 6)
ops-runner: scaling command: `kubectl scale deploy/model-loader --replicas=6 -n prod` — in progress
kevin: also enabling shortcut routing to model-quantized-v1 for low-latency tier (temporary) — will update routing table
kevin: routing change: `route-rule: inference.default -> model-quantized-v1 (fallback) for 10% traffic`
sophie: taking notes for handoff — what's customer impact? do we need a customer advisory?
kevin: customer impact: increased tail latency for high-context embedding requests and cold-starts; estimated affected requests ~0.7% of global traffic, but higher for customers with large model artifacts. Identified 3 high-volume tenants seeing >90th percentile errors: Acme Corp, BetaLabs, OmniRetail
kevin: severity: p95 user-visible slowness for a small percentage; not full outage. Recommend CC to CSMs for the three tenants and internal incident postmortem
maria: backup job paused, infra will set throttling on nightly backup and move snapshot to off-peak windows. I'll open a follow-up ticket INFRA-4123
kevin: scaling completed, replicas 6 -> healthy pods across nodes; p99 now ~980ms and dropping
kevin: routing rollback ready if instability persists, otherwise keep fallback for 30m and monitor
sophie: thanks — I'll take next 30m watch and finalise handoff to night oncall at 03:55Z. Summary for handoff: cause — backup-induced disk IO causing model cold-load delays; mitigation — paused backup, scaled model-loader, fallback routing to quantized model; customer impact — small fraction of requests, three tenants flagged; actions — INFRA-4123, follow-up with CSMs
kevin: dropping a short runbook note:
```
- If p99 > 1.5s: pause backup, scale model-loader, enable fallback routing
- If p99 > 3s or error rate rises: escalate to eng-runtime and infra oncall
- Create postmortem link and notify CSMs for affected tenants
```
ops-runner: incident-bot note: manual mitigations performed by @maria @tarun @kevin; monitoring scheduled 5m checks
incident-bot: Status update: p99 back within threshold (<= 1200ms) at 2024-06-21T03:30:40Z — continuing watch
sophie: acked handoff, will monitor and update in 15m. tagging @cs to prep customer notes if we see regression :bell:
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident PD-98321 acknowledged by kevin, assigned to kevin
kevin: thanks all, will file short incident writeup after stable. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: RESOLVED: Alert cleared at 2024-06-21T03:34:00Z — reason: backup paused + scaling + fallback routing.
